signal: dbt Labs completed its merger with Fivetran to form a combined data layer for AI, and shipped dbt Copilot for AI-assisted data operations.

email.body1:
Chris, saw dbt Labs and Fivetran finalized the merger into a single data layer for AI, with dbt Copilot now in the mix.

Merging two motions usually means a far bigger account map than the team can cover before things settle. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for the combined dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit the combined number
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

After a merger, pipeline targets usually jump faster than the combined team can cover. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book against the new account base, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your patch needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating two GTM motions is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a post-merger data motion? I'll tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
